title: Migrate existing SharePoint agents
subtitle: Review each .agent agent, then convert it manually with one of two Microsoft paths.

steps.title: Review each existing .agent agent
steps.evidence: Review each existing .agent agent and upgrade only those still used

steps.title: Use the SharePoint builder path
steps.evidence: Use the Upgrade button in the SharePoint builder to convert the .agent file into a new skill.

steps.title: Or use a Copilot in SharePoint skill
steps.evidence: a Copilot in SharePoint skill to convert agents manually, one agent at a time.
